meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 给你的助手接入 Signal:通过 signal-cli 设备关联,以你手机上已有的号码收发消息,无需新号码或机器人 API。支持 Markdown 格式、引用回复、私聊打字状态;语音只提示不转写。
howto.when: 当你要给助手添加 Signal 渠道时接管,例如在 /setup 中选择 Signal,或要求接入 Signal、改用独立号码注册。

say.text: 把 Signal 接入我的助手,用我手机上的号码关联
say.note: 会显示二维码,用手机扫码完成链接

say.text: 给刚发消息的 Signal 群建会话,接到我的助手上
say.note: 先给该群发条消息,再创建接线

say.text: 给这个 Signal 用户授予 owner 访问权限
say.note: 未授权的用户会被 not_member 丢弃

howto.what_en: Adds Signal to your assistant via signal-cli device-link: it sends and receives as the number on your phone, with no new number or bot API. Markdown, quoted replies and DM typing indicators work; voice is flagged, not transcribed.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you ask to add the Signal channel to the assistant — for example choosing it during /setup — or to register a dedicated number instead of linking.

say_en.text: Add Signal to my assistant, linking it with the number on my phone.
say_en.note: Prints a QR code to scan as a linked device

say_en.text: Wire the Signal group I just messaged to my assistant.
say_en.note: Send a message to the group first, then create the wiring

say_en.text: Grant owner access to this Signal user.
say_en.note: Not-yet-granted users are dropped as not_member
